digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor command — link-audit subcommand for graph validation and repair
propositions: LINK events written before comparability became structural remain unresolved on read, causing ancestors to block descendants and cousin edges to distort scheduling queries (ready, next-batch)

rebar doctor scans all net-active blocking edges, classifies them as ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, or unreadable by asking the current resolver what each edge should be, and optionally repairs safe findings

rebar doctor --repair writes replacement links before removing stale ones to ensure no dependency is lost on interruption, and refuses to repair ambiguous-pair (two net-active links on the same ordered pair) and closed-source replacements
rebar doctor --repair refuses to run while a reconciler pass is in flight and does not hold a store-wide lock, acquiring and releasing per-event to avoid self-deadlock
Read-only rebar doctor does not trigger store reconvergence; --repair does via init_only flag
18 bad edges were found on the repository tracker; 12 were repaired (9 ancestor-blocking + 3 mis-escalated), 8 residuals remain with closed BLOCKED endpoints and thus cannot affect scheduling
